title: ErrorEnvelope
description: Unified error envelope format used across VoiceStudio API responses. Aligns with backend/api/v3/models.ErrorDetail and StandardErrorResponse.

code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g. INVALID_INPUT, NOT_FOUND, ENGINE_ERROR)

field.description: Field that caused the error (for validation errors)

recovery_suggestion.description: Suggested action to resolve the error
